content: Apo u wibaabani ina dewadewa duma po mei tu luguguya, po mei yada tu winoyanoyahi hai wibaabani, ma luhogala u nugonugou ega ina memae, apo u luguguyahi hina wiginouli yabayababa po mei inaga hina ilawi ma himogo hina huwehuwena yababaya.

Ma apo tau Yaubada a tu bahapiko po ginouli gowagowadahi a hanapugehi po a hanapu duma po u witumaganagei a baha po oya hina nae uheiya, ma luhogala u nugonugou ega ina memae apo tau mei lawa yabayababa.
Ma inapa u gapola atapuhi tu dayadayabu a welehi ma hiniu a palihaleya po hina apapuya hoi ani witalaguyaba, ma luhogala u nugonugou ega ina memae u bagibagi anona apega a tuhagaya.
Luhogala dewa atapuhi i gelagonihi, luhogala i’mtaibagibagi po i lunugohegohegoya lawa uyahihi, ma ega ita yamgenagenalili, ma ega ita nugonugotuhu meya po ita nugonugogegae,
ma ega ita tanitanigapota. Luhogala ega ita yamgaganu ma ega ita lauhinidoodola ma ega ita laubigo.
Luhogala dewa apapoena binei ega ita kaokaoha ma dewa dumadumaluna binei e kaokaoha.
Luhogala e hagahaga momohita. Luhogala e laimoineta. Luhogala e inugonugotuhu lagoneta. Luhogala e yamtaibagibagiyeta.
Uyahinei luhogala apega ina kokoe ma tauhi Yaubada a tu bahapiko hai baha apo hina kokoe. Tauhi pona geha he ibaabaniyehi bahahi apo hina kokoe. Tauhi tu hanahanapu hai hanapu apo ina kokoe.
Babana ita hanapu geka hougana tupo hotana ma gasi ata bahapiko tupo hotahi.
Ma houga e nenei apo hanapu dumadumaluna ina geleta po hanapu odubona ta winugoguluwi.
Tau lolowa a itewela po u dewa mei tewela ma geka hougana a inugomagula po logaloga hai wibaabani po hai dewa po hai winugonugotuhu u nugonugou amaka hi kokoe.

Geka hougahi ata winugohiyahiyawa hi wigahugahu, ma yohola apo ta galena imahiyeya. Ma tau hanapu tupo hotana a hanapugeya, ma tamogi yohola apo atapuna a hanapugena imahiyeya, apo geka hougana Yaubada ina hanapugena dumau yaka.
Ginouli tonuga memewahagahi: witumagana, nugotuhu lagona, luhogala. Tonugahi geka naka luhogala i lata duma.
